description: Fires when column 2 holds exactly two stones (next stone there would land on row 2), mainly in the opening (up to about move 7) or the late game (move 28+, most columns full). In the middlegame it fires mostly only when column 2 is my stone with the opponent's stone on top. Column 2 with 3 stones fires only very late; 1 or 4+ stones never.
effect: Very small: forcing it high lowers the probability of playing column 2 by about 0-3 points (shifting it to another candidate); setting it to zero has the reverse, similarly tiny effect.
notes: H1 heights[2]==2: F1 0.385 (recall 0.90). Adding game-stage gating (ply<=7 or >=28) and colour (me under them) in mid game: F1 0.670, P 0.53, R 0.91, AUROC 0.94, sim share 0.75. Finer colour/ply split gave no gain. Mid-game suppression is not explained by heights elsewhere (flat boards at ply 10 also suppress) and looks like a positional/stage effect; late-game recovery not fully understood. Activation is graded, so many near-threshold FPs remain.
